none: PAS NLM-B11533: Strap End from Bigby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Possible Strap End fragment. Cast flat plate bearing nine ring and dot scattered across its display face. The object was probably oval-ended - both the curved sides appear - and tapered towards one end; a concave edge hints at a more complex form at the other end.
